newsitem.title: FRANCE: Five skiers killed in French avalanches.
newsitem.headline: Five skiers killed in French avalanches.

text.p: Five skiers were killed in a series of avalanches in the French Alps and Pyrenees mountains on Sunday, rescue services said.
Nine people accompanying an Italian ski instructor were swept away while skiing off piste near La Plagne in the Alps.

Rescuers located them quickly through their special emergency beacons but two skiers were dead and a third died afterwards in hospital. Radio France Info said at least two of the dead were German women.

A fourth person, a Frenchman, was killed earlier in the same area and a fifth person was killed in the Pyrenees near the Spanish border, rescue services said. No further details were immediately available.
